text: Director, Midway City Sanitary District

I am honored to have served the residents of the Midway City Sanitary District and remain committed to providing reliable sewer and sanitation services, protecting our environment, and serving our community.

During my service, I have supported infrastructure improvements, cybersecurity initiatives, grant opportunities, long-term planning, and expanded communication with residents through radio, social media, community events, and educational outreach. I have also supported programs that promote recycling, waste reduction, and environmental awareness.

My commitment to public service includes serving as Vice President of the Westminster School District, Planning Commissioner and Traffic Commissioner for the City of Westminster, and a classified employee with the Garden Grove Unified School District. These experiences have provided me with valuable knowledge of local government, education, and the needs of our community.

Moving forward, I will continue to focus on maintaining and improving our infrastructure, protecting our environment, strengthening community outreach, and ensuring clear communication with residents. I am proud of the progress we have made and grateful for the opportunity to continue serving the community.

text: Director, Midway City Sanitary District

It has been an honor to serve as your Director on the Midway City Sanitary District Board. I am running for re-election to continue delivering reliable, affordable, and accountable services for our community.

During my tenure, MCSD has maintained one of the lowest trash rates in Orange County while keeping the District financially strong. We have zero debt, grown our reserves, and protected taxpayer dollars through careful planning and responsible budgeting. These results do not happen by accident; they come from discipline, transparency, and a commitment to putting residents first.

We are also preparing for the future. The District has completed a comprehensive Sewer Master Plan and begun implementation to strengthen our infrastructure, improve long-term reliability, and guide smart investments for generations to come. We have acquired strategic real estate holdings to support future expansion and provide long-term value to the District.
I am proud that MCSD has earned awards for fiscal transparency and operational innovation, recognizing our commitment to sound financial management and forward-thinking technology.
With your support, I will continue working to keep rates low, services dependable, finances debt-free, and decisions focused on all residents and future generations.
Humbly, I ask for your vote. Thank you again

text: Businessowner/Planning Commissioner

For more than 30 years, I have proudly lived and worked in Westminster as a local business owner, long-time resident, and dedicated community volunteer. I am honored to serve as a Westminster Planning Commissioner, where I promote responsible growth, thoughtful development, and decisions that strengthen our neighborhoods and support local businesses.

Throughout the years, I have donated my time and resources to charitable organizations, community events, and local causes because I believe strong communities are built by people who are willing to serve and give back.
I am running for Director of the Midway City Sanitary District to continue serving our community and protecting the essential services residents rely on every day.
My priorities are to:

Keep rates affordable,
Maintain reliable trash and sewer services,
Plan wisely for future infrastructure needs,
Protect our environment, and
Ensure taxpayer dollars are managed with honesty, transparency, and accountability.

As a business owner, I understand responsible budgeting, customer service, and practical decision-making. As a Planning Commissioner, I listen to residents, work collaboratively, and understand the importance of planning for our community’s future.
I respectfully ask for your vote so we can continue building a cleaner, safer, stronger, and more financially responsible community for everyone.

text: Director, Midway City Sanitary District
Dear Neighbor,
Thank you for the trust you’ve placed in me as a school board member, city councilman, and now on the Midway City Sanitary District board.
As a father, homeowner, and taxpayer, I’ve spent the last four years working to keep our community healthy, safe, and clean.
Here’s what I’ve done for you on the Sanitary District board:
Kept our trash collection service rates one of the lowest in Orange County;
Helped keep our sewer system spill-free for over 1000 days, protecting our neighborhoods, streets, and local waterways.
Championed the District’s first-ever 5-year plan to invest in our sewer system, prevent backups, protect against emergencies, and keep our service reliable for years to come;
Grew community outreach so more residents know what district services are available and how to use them; and
Held 20 free bulky-item clean-up events that helped residents clear over 400 tons of junk off our streets;
With your support, I’ll keep working hard to protect our community, keep rates low, and deliver great service.
Please vote to re-elect me, Sergio Contreras, for Midway City Sanitary District.
Email me anytime at: sergiocontrerasjr@yahoo.com www.sergiocontreras.com

text: Retired EEO Manager
Donald J. Lank – DonaldJLank.com
As an Orange County resident since 1995 and a proud Westminster resident since 1998, I have dedicated my career and community service to integrity, accountability, and public service.

I served the United States Postal Service for more than 43 years, retiring as Headquarters Area Manager of Equal Employment Opportunity Dispute Resolution, overseeing programs supporting nearly 89,000 employees. I then served as Chief Equal Employment Officer for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Los Angeles District, until retiring from federal service in 2022.
Today, I serve as President of the Springarden Homeowners Association and as an appointed Commissioner on the Westminster Parks and Recreation Commission and the Westminster Traffic Commission.
I am seeking your vote for the Midway City Sanitary District Board to provide experienced leadership, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and accountability.

Looking ahead, I will support efforts to preserve the capacity of Orange County’s three active landfills—Frank R. Bowerman, Olinda Alpha, and Prima Deshecha. Separating leftover food and other organic waste reduces methane emissions, conserves landfill space, helps control future disposal costs, and promotes a cleaner, more sustainable community.
I will protect taxpayer dollars, maintain reliable infrastructure, and ensure responsive, dependable public service.
I respectfully ask for your vote and the opportunity to serve our community.
